purpose: Convert the already-adjudicated Puertos del Estado and TED public probes into prospective observer chains without granting them likelihood, price, quantity, market-clearing or automatic M2/M3 authority.
common_prohibitions: no account creation, authentication, payment, acceptance of terms or contact with source owners
no bulk or recursive historical download
no target read before its own freeze permits it
no post-hoc variable, product, port, CPV, geography, window or notice-type substitution
no fitting, posterior update, Z_post update, scoring or cross-source likelihood pooling in this observer campaign
no gas, electricity, fuel or administered-price target
no global winner and no automatic promotion

puertos_chain.source: Puertos del Estado monthly statistics workbook
puertos_chain.future_capture_unit: one official workbook for one newly published reference month
future_capture_order: record retrieval timestamp and source URL
save first observed response bytes and HTTP metadata
verify reference month, workbook date, sheet identity, units and labels
extract only frozen fields and preserve all gate failures
explicit_exclusions: passengers, cruise calls and passenger vehicles as industrial-production covariates

required: same selected field labels or an explicitly mapped documented schema change
no formula-derived value when a published value cell exists

model_candidacy_gate.timeliness: each observer byte must precede the target-specific forecast freeze
model_candidacy_gate.required_next_step: a new target-specific preregistration before any fit or likelihood contribution

ted_chain.future_capture_unit: one bounded calendar-month event-count cut with an immutable query body and response hash
frozen_dimensions: CPV prefix 44 and explicitly frozen subprefixes
country or NUTS place-of-performance level kept separate
counting_rules: deduplicate by publication-number within each cut
retain all CPV codes attached to a notice but count the notice once per frozen aggregation cell
never treat duplicated CPV or place arrays as multiple awards
preserve missing place, CPV, date and value indicators

required: duplicate and amendment behavior explicitly measured

model_candidacy_gate.timeliness: each event cut must precede the target-specific forecast freeze
model_candidacy_gate.required_next_step: a new target-specific preregistration before any fit or likelihood contribution
